cohort: Infants suffering from moderate-to-severe HIE and healthy controls
finding: The study found that systemic inflammatory indices, particularly NLR, were significantly higher in infants with moderate-to-severe HIE compared to controls and could serve as reliable predictors of HIE risk.
gest_age: Median 39 weeks (HIE group) and 38 weeks (control group)
birth_weight: Median 3,165 g (HIE group) and 3,045 g (control group)
